surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the alternating pulses of TMA and H2O for alumina deposition and TDEAH and H2O for hafnia deposition. The mechanism includes the formation of surface hydroxyl groups and the subsequent reaction with TMA or TDEAH, leading to the formation of Al-O-Al and Hf-O-Al bonds, respectively, with the release of byproducts such as CH4 and NH3.
